FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 37
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/02/2026
Senate Bill 37 as introduced would decrease municipal sales and use tax receipts, beginning in
FY 2027, by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of purchases made by
Alabama residents in municipalities they do not reside in, as provided in this bill.
